svg.title: Testing Toad
svg.desc: FrogPilot (driver-assistance software for cars) Discord role icon: a smiling frog with a bushy ginger walrus mustache and a black beret pulled down over its head, in a white button-down shirt over a black T-shirt, wearing a clipboard on a red lanyard stamped BUSTED in red, with a checklist of red X boxes and a pen.
